owner_instruction.context: Milestone 2 step 2 had been left as an unauthorized, separate decision since the M2 scope proposal (docs/M2-SCOPE-PROPOSAL.md section 5), pending the owner's own choice of size and review standard. The owner's instruction was read as asking for a reasoned recommendation to review and authorize, consistent with how every other scope or protocol decision in this project has been made -- not as delegating the decision itself. A recommendation was given in chat (pilot scope: 2 prior quarters for the same 23 issuers; full Milestone-1-standard review, citing the 100-event over-scoping lesson as the reason not to commit to the full 4-8 quarter range up front) and put to the owner as two questions.

owner_decision.scope_question: What scope for Milestone 2 step 2 (data depth)?
owner_decision.review_question: What review standard applies to the new candidates?
owner_decision.review_chosen: Same as Milestone 1: full review, one named reviewer per event (Recommended)
owner_decision.how_recorded: Selected via the question tool, not typed; recorded here as the chosen option labels, the same convention this project already used for the 2026-09-23 target-amendment decision (see docs/M1-READINESS-ASSESSMENT.md, 'Target amendment' section, and reports/m1-acceptance-declaration-2026-09-26.json, owner_decisions_relied_on).

what_this_authorizes: Extending the session calendar backward to cover 2025 (nre/calendar-2025.json), kept entirely separate from the frozen nre/calendar-2026.json.

A new, separate protocol (config/m2-step2-protocol.json) covering 2025-06-01 to 2026-01-04 -- the two quarterly earnings cycles immediately before Milestone 1's already-frozen window, for the same 23 already-accepted issuers only.
Discovering and freezing that protocol's Item 2.02 8-K candidates from real SEC EDGAR submissions, outcome-blind, the same way Milestone 1's frozen cohort was built.

Reviewing those candidates to the same standard Milestone 1 used: one named reviewer, full chronology and identity evidence per event, no independent second reviewer (per the 2026-09-22 review-standard amendment, which this pilot continues rather than re-deciding).
what_this_does_not_authorize: Any change to config/pilot.json, the frozen 243-candidate membership, nre/calendar-2026.json, or any Milestone 1 record.
The wider sizing options (the 205 unreviewed frozen candidates, or more issuers) -- a separate decision if the pilot's real throughput supports it.
A lighter or sampled review standard -- explicitly declined; see the review_chosen field above.
Any prediction, score, ranking or model.
pilot_success_criterion: Not a numeric target. config/m2-step2-protocol.json sets minimum_eligible_events and minimum_unique_issuers to 1 deliberately, so there is no pressure to force a borderline candidate through to hit a count. The pilot's actual purpose is to measure real solo-review throughput for this depth push and report it honestly, whatever it turns out to be.
